column1: # Verified corrections to deck extraction, applied as an overlay.
# The extracted CSVs stay exactly as the extractor produced them: they are the
# record of what the parser saw, and editing them in place would destroy the
# ability to tell a parser bug from a source change. Values here were read off
# the deck by hand, are cited to the page that carries them, and are applied on
# top at composite time. Anything in this file is a claim about a specific PDF
# and can be re-checked against it.
